title: Kanban changes
description: A Kanban's changes (AD-20, FR-20, latex-kanban-timeline design decision 4, kanban-order design decision 3): the output format's changes narrowed to two operations of the one generic diff on the flat list of cards grouped by column, addressed as AD-13's reference syntax without brackets: set of a card's column, item.card.column, the value the ID of the column the card moved to; move of a card, item.card, with an optional after naming the card of the same column it follows (none when first in its column), never a parent. A card moved to another column gives its set, then a move only when it stands elsewhere than the sent order puts it. A Kanban never adds or removes a card, edits a label or a description, or changes a column. The move of a card within its column is in the output format since kanban-order. In the output format since latex-kanban-timeline.
